purpose: Provides accessible navigation or inline references with inherited typography, or a medium body preset when sized.

notes: Pass navigate through VeliProvider when href should use client-side routing.

useWhen: Embedding a reference within surrounding text.
Pairing navigation text with a leading or trailing icon.

avoidWhen.situation: The control performs an action without navigation.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use an action control with button semantics.

approvedPatterns: Omit size to inherit typography from the parent context.
Set size when the link should use a medium body typography preset and matching icon scale.
Use default intent for standard navigation and secondary intent for quieter navigation.
Choose no underline, hover underline, or persistent underline according to context.
limitations: Omitting size inherits typography; setting size applies medium body presets rather than only resizing icons.
accessibility: Use link semantics for navigation destinations.
Keep link text descriptive when icons are present.
responsive: The inline layout follows the typography and available space of its parent.
rtl: Place directional icons according to the active writing direction.
